description: This file contains helper functions for provider modules, including request handling, certificate management, string conversion, and utility functions for asynchronous execution and data filtering.

methods.name: check_item
methods.description: Checks if an item is in an allowed list, raises ValueError with suggestions if not.

methods.name: get_querystring
methods.description: Converts a dictionary into a URL query string, excluding specified keys.

methods.name: get_python_request_settings
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP request settings from system configuration.

methods.name: get_requests_session
methods.description: Creates and configures a requests.Session object based on system settings and environment variables.

methods.name: get_async_requests_session
methods.description: Creates and configures an aiohttp.ClientSession with system settings and environment variables.

methods.name: amake_request
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous HTTP request with optional callback for response processing.

methods.name: amake_requests
methods.description: Performs multiple asynchronous HTTP requests concurrently.

methods.name: combine_certificates
methods.description: Combines a certificate file with a bundle into a single certificate file.

methods.name: make_request
methods.description: Performs a synchronous HTTP request with optional headers and parameters.

methods.name: to_snake_case
methods.description: Converts a string from CamelCase or spaced format to snake_case.

methods.name: maybe_coroutine
methods.description: Checks if a function is a coroutine and runs it accordingly.

methods.name: run_async
methods.description: Runs an async function in a blocking context.

methods.name: filter_by_dates
methods.description: Filters a list of Data objects by start and end dates.

methods.name: safe_fromtimestamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to datetime, supporting negative timestamps on Windows.
